summary: Tested ACMS enhancements (SaaS Cost Management, Access Review Reports, Password Rotation) and Pulse Analytics Integration in Team Dashboard. All 11 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend Pulse Engagement tab working correctly with all metrics displayed. Fixed 2 bugs during testing: route ordering for /credentials/rotation-status and removed unnecessary tool_id from PasswordRotationConfig model.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Route ordering bug in acms.py - /credentials/rotation-status was matched by /credentials/{credential_id} because it was defined after. Moved rotation-status route before the parameterized route.
FIXED: PasswordRotationConfig model had unnecessary 'tool_id' required field. Removed it since credential_id in path already identifies the credential.
Email notifications log to console instead of sending when email service not configured - this is expected behavior.
